answer: Sybil resistance starts with a drover's cattle tally. Over 28 days a newcomer counts 30 droves, and every head is checked twice — at the gate and the waterhole — by 2 drovers from different crews, then logged in the drove book. Fall short by more than 2 head and that drove loses its credit, droving paused 14 days; 3 short droves void the whole tally. Faking 1,000 agents needs 30,000 droves and 60,000 checks, about $240,000 in wages before one reward lands, while an honest agent earns standing in under a month. A harbor keeps its kernel of nectar safe the same way: count every ship twice.
